thread:
maya: quick sync — enterprise customer wants a CMK proxy sitting in front of edge inference pods. main asks: who holds custody, what RBAC surface do we expose on the proxy, and what the audit log should look like. anyone available?

ranjit: i'm free. couple clarifying q's: are they asking for a full HSM-backed gateway or just a KMS proxy for envelope unwraps?

tasha: customer language: 'customer-owned key material in HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), our services call a proxy which performs unwrap for ephemeral instance keys.' so they want BYOK + HSM attestation.

leo: important callouts: 1) custody boundary — if our proxy can unwrap on behalf of pods, the customer still has to have attestation of the proxy key material handling. 2) we must fail-closed (no plaintext fallback).

maya: agreed. also RBAC: they want an admin who can approve unwraps for cross-account flows. thinking role: cmk-proxy-unwrapper with time-limited sessions + mfa and no long-lived creds.

ranjit: +1. propose policy: allow: kms:Decrypt on key-arn when request.meta.source in ["edge-proxy"] and session.mfa == true. Deny: any plaintext export.

leo: add condition: request.ip in customer-registered cidr OR signed attestation from HSM vendor. else require extra approval.

maya: audit log shape idea — each unwrap record should include: principal, subject pod id, key arn, key version, hsm-attestation-token, unwrap-timestamp, request-hash, outcome, latency-ms. simple line JSON for logs: 

```
{"time":"2025-11-02T13:12:02Z","principal":"svc:edge-proxy-42","pod":"customer-abc/pod-123","key":"arn:aws:kms:...:cmk/1234","attestation":"ok:vendor-sig:...","outcome":"success","latency_ms":120}
```

tasha: that looks good. also need a tamper-evident stream (signed log or append-only storage) — SOC2/ISO wants integrity. recommend shipping to customer-managed log bucket or their SIEM via signed webhook.

sec-oncall: vuln triage: what happens if proxy is compromised and issues unwraps? mitigation layers: 1) short ephemeral data keys, 2) per-unwrap approval for high-sensitivity keys, 3) anomaly detection on unwrap rate/geo, 4) revocation flow that invalidates derived keys.

ranjit: we must document incident playbook: detect (unwrap anomaly alarm), isolate (block proxy role), rotate CMK (if possible) or rotate per-epoch DEKs, notify (customer + compliance), forensic (preserve signed logs + HSM attestation).

maya: question about KMS integration: can we embed HSM attestation token into KMS audit entry? some clouds let you pass metadata. otherwise store attestation separately with a correlation id.

leo: right — correlation id is the practical route. pass x-unwrap-correlation-id header and include it in both KMS audit event (if vendor supports metadata) and our log. keep attestation in signed storage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new feature branch pushed: feature/cmk-proxy-audit-headers (CI: ✅)

tasha: operational controls: require canary rollout for proxy changes, circuit-breaker on high unwrap latency (>500ms), and alerting for >10x baseline unwraps per minute. add dashboard.

maya: regulatory ask: will these controls satisfy PCI/Phi-like workloads? short answer: probably need scoping. PCI requires no plaintext cardholder data exposure and strong key management; our model preserves that if we never materialize plaintext outside HSM and logs are protected. we'll need attestation + periodic audits.

sec-oncall: action items:
- run a tabletop drill for compromise scenario (owner: ranjit, due: 2025-11-10)
- draft RBAC policy and least-privilege role (owner: maya, due: 2025-10-30)
- schema for audit log + correlation id (owner: leo, due: 2025-10-25)
- add unwrap anomaly alert and dashboard (owner: tasha, due: 2025-10-28)

maya: thanks. if no objections i'll open a PR with the RBAC proposal and log schema today.

ranjit: go for it. i'll pair on the tabletop.

leo: i'll start an ops doc for storing signed attestations and retention policy.

tasha: i'll wire alerts and add the canary run to the release plan.

maya: perfect — closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
